correctness.rationale: The one-step idempotence f²=f forces each fibre to be a rooted coloured star; the product of leaf-colour permutations and equal-star permutations is the complete automorphism group. Rigidity therefore means distinct star types and at most one leaf of each colour. Selecting each of q binom(q,j) rigid j-leaf types at most once gives R_q(z)=product_{j=0}^q (1+z^(j+1))^(q binom(q,j)). Sum of all type sizes gives sharp capacity N_q=q 2^(q-1)(q+2); subset-sum induction yields all sizes 0..N_q and complement yields coefficient symmetry. Arbitrary multiplicities yield unrestricted Euler product and divisor recurrence; the fixed-q logarithmic growth follows from its exact Boltzmann log-partition with C=q zeta(q+1), Chebyshev concentration and monotonicity of counts. Independent separate direct idempotent-function and colour enumeration for q=1,2 at small carrier sizes matched rigid polynomial; this finite check cannot prove the asymptotic.
